open_points.subject: Project-overview component failure classification
open_points.text: “the project overview answers a failed part as `temporarily_unavailable` with no value” does not say which failures count as a failed part, while the same convention maps Registry failures to 502 and persistence failures to 500
open_points.question: Which failures during an individual overview component are converted to `temporarily_unavailable`, and which still fail the whole overview request under the route error policy?
options: Convert every declared Registry or persistence failure occurring after authorization while building a component
Convert only explicitly designated dependency failures; propagate all other declared failures
Convert Registry read failures only; propagate persistence failures
open_points.default_guess: Convert declared post-authorization Registry and persistence read failures for an individual component, but propagate authentication, authorization, input, conflict, and unexpected failures.

witness.initial: A staff member has passed the project-read guard for an active project; budget, payments and photos are readable, but the expense repository raises a persistence failure while the overview is composed.
events: The staff member requests the project overview.
`derived_views.build_project_overview` starts composing the parts and the expense-part persistence read fails.
outcomes: The route returns a successful `ProjectOverview` with `expenses_availability = temporarily_unavailable`, no expenses value, and the other available parts.
The persistence failure follows the stated 500 mapping and the whole overview request fails with an empty 500 response.
witness.observer: The staff API caller sees either a partial overview or no overview.
